2b5d8d1939b5d173695f31607637afe0.overview: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Afraid of losing his place in Andy's heart, Woody plots against Buzz. But when circumstances separate Buzz and Woody from their owner, the duo eventually learns to put aside their differences.
2b5d8d1939b5d173695f31607637afe0.tagline: Hang on for the comedy that goes to infinity and beyond!

2bac7fec530be5e928cdbd72e170132e.overview: After the death of a United States Senator, the idealistic Jefferson Smith is appointed as his replacement in Washington. The naive and earnest new senator soon finds himself battling political corruption.
2bac7fec530be5e928cdbd72e170132e.tagline: Romance, drama, laughter and heartbreak... created out of the very heart and soil of America!

2bba167e19ca924c0ca6457977937959.overview: A strike at a French sausage factory contributes to the estrangement of a married filmmaker and his reporter wife.

2be48a94ab575cb5d0084c4b66bd0475.overview: Episodic journey of journalist Marcello who struggles to find his place in the world, torn between the allure of Rome's elite social scene and the stifling domesticity offered by his girlfriend, all the while searching for a way to become a serious writer.
2be48a94ab575cb5d0084c4b66bd0475.tagline: The world’s most talked about movie today!

2be4b3aeb48dc0a117ac75dd8155bd82.overview: An eccentric lottery winner who lives alone on a remote island tries to make his fantasies come true by getting his favourite musicians to perform at his home.
2be4b3aeb48dc0a117ac75dd8155bd82.tagline: He's getting the band back together.

2bf02d54762bcaeacdafb7bd6fa02ae1.overview: Two men, part tramp, part pilgrim, are on their way from France to Santiago de Compostela in Spain. On their way, they meet a vast assortment of characters—some truculent, some violent, and some bizarre; they experience many adventures—some mysterious, some erotic, some even supernatural.
